redMasters.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Make ONE production transparent PNG game sprite. Image 1 is the exact silhouette/identity target, NOT a font suggestion. Image 2 is the approved RED ALPHA material/camera style reference; DO NOT render alpha, replace the subject with the silhouette in image 1. Preserve the target's distinctive thick rounded stroke proportions, holes, hooks and terminals; no invented strokes. Render as solid red satin enamel with shallow 3D extrusion and precise narrow bevels, same restrained soft studio key light as approved alpha. Front is unequivocal saturated RED approximately #ff0000 with darker red side walls. Very slight three-quarter yaw about 8 degrees shows right thickness; frontal silhouette dominates. Square canvas, object about 80% of canvas in its longest dimension, centered, keep proportions. True transparent alpha background INCLUDING all holes/openings. No plaque, pedestal, floor, background, glow, outside shadows, text or other symbols. Clean smooth antialiased contours, no stray edge pixels. Suitable at 100px on dark game board. Target subject: tall lowercase beta β, two enclosed holes, long straight left stem descending beneath its lower rounded bowl.
